findings.mechanism: Correlation identifiers generated per service rather than propagated by the transport. Logs cannot be correlated to a single request, so an on‑call engineer cannot retrieve all log lines for one request with a single query.
findings.remediation: Add a request_id argument to load and list_for_customer (and any downstream calls), propagate it via contextvars, and include it in all logger calls, e.g., logger.exception("could not list orders for customer %s request_id=%s", customer_id, request_id).
findings.arithmetic: No numeric threshold; the issue is the absence of a request‑level identifier, which makes correlation impossible.
